idea: Internal web app lets hourly retail employees post and claim shift swaps themselves, with manager approval required only when the swap changes total weekly hours beyond a threshold.
source: hand-authored by Claude Sonnet 5, offline in this session, by-layer Slicer variant -- see foundry/tools/slicer.yaml

pieces.text: Employees will actually use a self-serve app to post and claim swaps, instead of continuing to arrange swaps informally by text and telling a manager after the fact.
A single weekly-hours-changed threshold can correctly separate swaps a manager should review from ones safe to auto-approve, across most employees' actual schedules.
Auto-approving swaps below the threshold won't create labor-law or union-rule violations -- overtime, minimum rest between shifts -- that a manager's review would have caught.
Letting employees self-serve swaps still reliably leaves every shift covered by someone qualified, rather than shifts going unclaimed and unnoticed until they start.
Managers will trust an auto-approval threshold enough to stop manually double-checking every swap -- the only way this actually saves anyone time.
